user.title: Set up Shipshape
user.description: Shipshape tracks recurring household chores by condition: each chore drifts from clean to due over its interval, and resets when you mark it done.

data.starter_library: Start with the built-in rooms and chores

data_description.starter_library: Turn this off to start empty or to import your own list.

people.title: People and phones
people.description: Choose who takes part in chores. Leave a phone empty to let Shipshape pick the phone linked to that person.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Every reminder is optional. Nothing is sent while vacation mode is on.

data.push_enabled: Chore pushes with Done and Snooze buttons
data.push_max: Most pushes per person per day
data.dashboard_path: Dashboard to open from a notification

data_description.digest_enabled: One summary per person of what is due today.
data_description.push_enabled: A separate notification for each of the most urgent chores.
data_description.announce_targets: Notify actions that speak, for example notify.alexa_media_kitchen.

calendar.title: Calendar bridge
calendar.description: Shipshape can keep one all-day event per due chore in another calendar, such as a Google calendar your Skylight syncs. The calendar must allow Home Assistant to create and delete events.

data.calendar_done_on_delete: Deleting the event marks the chore done

data_description.calendar_entity: Leave empty to turn the bridge off.
data_description.calendar_horizon: 0 shows a chore only on the day it is due.
data_description.calendar_done_on_delete: Lets you clear a due chore from the wall display. Events for chores that are not due yet are just dismissed.

skylight.title: Skylight Chores
skylight.description:
Sends due chores to Skylight's own Chores and reads completions back, using the private API of the Skylight app. Skylight does not support this and it can stop working at any time.

Status: {status}. Sync is currently {enabled}. Leave email and password empty to keep the current sign-in.

data_description.password: Used once to sign in. Only the resulting session tokens are stored.

skylight_code.title: Check your email
skylight_code.description: Skylight emailed a 6-digit code to the account owner. Enter it here.

skylight_profiles.title: Skylight profiles
skylight_profiles.description: Skylight needs every chore to belong to a profile. Chores with no assignee go to the default profile.

error.invalid_auth: Skylight rejected that email or password.
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Skylight, or its sign-in page has changed.
error.rate_limited: Skylight is rate limiting sign-ins. Wait a while and try again.
error.credentials_needed: Enter your Skylight email and password.

abort.skylight_failed: Skylight did not respond as expected. Nothing was changed. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
abort.skylight_no_frames: No Skylight devices were found on that account.
abort.skylight_no_profiles: That Skylight has no profiles to assign chores to.

complete_chore.name: Complete chore
complete_chore.description: Marks a chore done and restarts its interval.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The chore's id. Use this or the name.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Zone name, needed when several rooms have a chore with this name.

snooze_chore.name: Snooze chore
snooze_chore.description: Hides a due chore for a number of days.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The chore's id. Use this or the name.

make_due.name: Make chore due
make_due.description: Marks a chore as due right now, whatever its interval says.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The chore's id. Use this or the name.

add_chore.name: Add chore
add_chore.description: Adds a chore, creating the zone if needed.

months.name: Fixed months
months.description: Month numbers for a chore tied to specific months instead of an interval.

import_data.name: Import chores
import_data.description: Loads zones and chores from a structured list.

data.name: Data
data.description: An object with a zones list.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Delete all existing zones and chores first.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.description: Spread starting conditions so everything is not due at once.

export_data.name: Export chores
export_data.description: Returns all zones and chores in the import format.

set_vacation.name: Set vacation mode
set_vacation.description: Freezes or resumes every chore's clock.

send_reminders.name: Send reminders now
send_reminders.description: Sends one kind of reminder immediately, whether or not it is switched on. Useful for testing.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Runs the calendar bridge and Skylight sync immediately.
